dataset.source: Synthetic instruction/operation pairs, every one executed against the RDX edit engine before being written. No human musical-quality labels.
dataset.split: By phrasing family: the wordings in valid and test never appear in train, so validation measures new phrasing rather than recall. Musical contexts are randomised independently.
dataset.targets: The assistant returns operations only. Summaries are generated by the engine from the real change, so the model is never trained to describe its own edit.
